statement: For the Lagrange Scenario A visibility runner, optional scenario-owned preStart verifies visibility-bound admission and runtime source identity before clusterFactory or cluster.start; stale preStart identity is refused before public-PG desired-state writes. Malformed or wrong-case admission is fail-closed with zero cluster construction, and an ordinary scenario without preStart retains its run contract. This Quest does not claim to gate CLI image-build or GCP host provisioning, which occur earlier; that wider CLI admission is an explicitly separate frontier. Prove the boundary with deterministic negative and positive runScenarios tests and a static ordering metric; no live run, new script, or new workflow is part of this unit.

constraints.statement: Missing, malformed, wrong-case and source-mismatched admissions cause no cluster construction; forged or stale execution tokens cause no public-PG write.
The preflight is an execution gate, not semantic proof or formation provenance, and cannot satisfy the separate five-node certification requirement.
An independent reviewer validates the ordering, refusal, positive-path, and harness fidelity tests before landing.
